page.layout: One column of running text. Printed page number and running head at the top. Left margin: manuscript annotations only (not transcribed). Catchword at lower right of the text block.

main_text.p: duabusque iudicum partib. fenfit. nam antiquitus pœna lege conftituta erat. Iudices uel uideri, uel non uideri fecif[?] feiudicabant. F. Imò scripta lex est de pluribus indefinitè. Itaque quotcunque sententiarum genera fuerint, nihil in-terest. semper enim maiori parti standum est. D. Utrum lex scripta de certo iudicum numero, si plurium sententias ratas esse iubeat, de duabus tantum, an etiam de plurib. partibus intelligenda sit.
Alterum exemplum. Lex est: „Vir fortis prœmio, quod optauerit, donetur. Qui fortiter fecerat, petit alterius uxorē in

page.notes: Top-left margin: a small printed-looking ornament or Hebrew-like mark, unreadable, not transcribed. Left margin: manuscript (handwritten) annotation beside "Alterum exemplum", not printed, not transcribed. Running head is decorative and only partly legible. Doubtful: "fecif[?]" (final letter unclear). Lex quotation shows „ at line starts; the quotation was kept as one paragraph. Printing errors kept: "plurib." and "Imò" as printed. "prœmio" and "uxorē" transcribed with the printed diacritics as far as legible.
